name: edit_string
description:
Edit a file by replacing an exact string match.
Best for small, single-point changes; for complex edits, multiple changes, or multiple edits to the same file, prefer apply_patch. Do not make multiple parallel calls to this tool against the same file.

path.description: File path. Supports absolute paths, workspace-relative paths, and ~/ paths.

old_string.description: Exact text to replace. Must match exactly, including whitespace and indentation.

new_string.description: Replacement text. Must differ from old_string.
